name: megalochrome-ripple
anchor: centre of the frame on the water surface line; place the layer so the impact point sits at the creature's feet / water contact point
blend: normal alpha compositing by default; additive (screen) is an approved alternate for bright water scenes

timing.strike: frame 0: centre glow at full brightness, first ring at radius 12
timing.expand: frames 0-11: 3 rings staggered 1/3 phase apart, each expanding 12 -> 120 px and fading to 0
timing.droplets: frames 0-11: 9 droplets rise upward from the surface and fade; they never fall back down (anti-gravity read)
timing.loop_point: frame 11 -> frame 0 is seamless: ring phases wrap at 1/3 offsets, droplet phases wrap per-droplet

usage: overlay as an independent sprite layer above the ground / below the creature, or above the creature's lower body for a splash-through read; never baked into a model or sheet
